Israel's response to the UK's decision to impose sanctions is "weak", said Daniel Levy. 

Speaking to Mathilda Mallinson on MEE Live, Levy also decried the "pathetic" response from voices in the UK Parliament critical of the move. https://t.co/N7SH2GVDfW

Britain's Foreign Secretary Ed Milliband announced the country's strongest package of sanctions against Israel’s illegal settlements on Tuesday, targeting the trade, finance and services that sustain their expansion across the occupied West Bank
